metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads from any platform, extracts frames, transcribes locally (no API key), and hands it all to Claude.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path) from YouTube, Instagram, X, Vimeo, TikTok or any yt-dlp site. Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or local mlx-whisper.
